title: Goff: Russell turns the mind-body problem around

statements.text: On Goff’s reading of Russell, the only window onto the nature of matter is attention to one’s own mind. The problem then turns around: a great deal is known about consciousness, and the open question is how matter fits around it.

sources.quote: According to Russell the only ‘window’ one has onto the nature of matter is provided by attention to one’s own mind.
Russellian wisdom tells us we know a lot about consciousness, but face a challenge seeing how matter fits around it.
